Dr Gilroy is truly wonderful — she listens carefully, gives me her full attention as if I’m her only patient that day, and never makes me feel rushed. Any referral has been clearly explained and has been prompt. The reception staff are always friendly, knowledgeable, and efficient, making the whole process of booking and attending appointments smooth and stress-free. All the staff are friendly, welcoming and know what they're doing, from the ANP to the nurses taking bloods.

been a patient at Norfolk Park Medical Centre for three years now, and throughout my time with this surgery—whether interacting with doctors, nurses, or receptionists—I have consistently felt treated with dignity and respect. This has truly been the best healthcare experience I've had in the UK since moving here in 2012.

One of the things that sets this practice apart is that it feels like a centre for the community—a place where patients are heard, seen, and cared for. Despite the immense pressures on the NHS, budget constraints, and service cuts, the staff at Norfolk Park go above and beyond to ensure their patients receive the care they need.

I particularly appreciate their proactive communication. Recently, I had an urgent medical matter, and when the doctor couldn't reach me on the first call (due to a phone issue), they didn't just move on. Instead, they tried calling three to four times, even messaging me to ensure I was aware of the situation. This level of dedication is rare—at other GP practices, if you miss a call, you often have to wait until the next day to try again. The extra effort here makes a real difference, especially for parents trying to navigate medical care for their children while juggling daily responsibilities.

Another standout aspect is the holistic approach to care. Today, I had an appointment for cervical screening with a nurse, and instead of just focusing on that single procedure, she took the time to review my overall health. She noticed I had missed a blood test and an asthma review, and she ensured that all my needs were addressed in one visit. More importantly, she made me feel like my health genuinely mattered to her—not just as a patient, but as a person. Her patience, attentiveness, and ability to sense the urgency of my concerns made all the difference.

This is the kind of medical care everyone deserves. While I recognize the challenges healthcare professionals face today, the team at Norfolk Park still manages to provide compassionate, patient-centred care.

My only suggestion would be to encourage more community involvement in shaping the development of the surgery. It would be wonderful if there were open evenings or workshops where the medical staff could engage with the community—not just reactively through appointments, but proactively by sharing learning, raising awareness about health issues, and providing a space where people could ask questions.
